mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal is generally healthful and suitable for stable blood sugar levels as it is low in simple carbohydrates and high in protein. Replacing the added cheese with a lower sodium option may enhance its healthfulness for someone managing blood pressure.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Tomato and Fried Eggs with Parmesan
mealAnalysis.meal_description: This dish consists of fresh tomato slices and fried eggs, topped with a light sprinkle of Parmesan cheese.
